verdict.rationale: Reflect documents both a custom URI deep-linking scheme (reflect://reflect?command=...) for triggering in-app actions and a REST-like API with OAuth2/PKCE for appending data and reading bookmarks, which together let developers script note creation/access outside the app. Missing for 10: no public OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt discoverable (probes returned 404), and no independent/hands-on developer reports confirming real-world workflow integration.
